name: Todoist
tagline: Dead-simple task manager — you're up and running in about a minute.
firstWin: your first task added and showing in your Today list
path: sign in or sign up (Google or email — it's quick)
you land on the Today view; click 'Add task' at the top (or just press the A key)
type a task, leave it due Today, and press Enter — it appears in your list, and that's the win
optional: Projects, labels, and reminders are all there when you want them, but you don't need any of that to get started.

knowledge.keywords: add task new create shortcut a key
knowledge.text: To add a task, click 'Add task' at the top of the list or just press the A key. Type it and hit Enter to save.

knowledge.keywords: today view due date schedule tomorrow
knowledge.text: The Today view shows what's due today. When adding a task you can type a due date in plain words like 'tomorrow 5pm' and Todoist schedules it automatically.
Click the circle to the left of a task to complete it — it checks off and leaves your list.
Projects in the left sidebar group related tasks. You don't need one to start — new tasks land in Inbox or Today by default.
